purpose: Record the bounded TaskManager five-residual repair probe before another fresh regression
observed_diff: TaskForm initData now returns independent defaults; inited copies the first task prop into formData and watches later changes.
The source mounted startup calls moved from parent inited to attached in source order.
A pure overdue helper replaces instance-method calls in computed; the component method delegates to it.
The template passes reactive tasks to getTaskCount, and the method uses the explicit argument.
Existing modal and drag/drop event bindings were preserved.
caveats: This is a single local repair of a previously generated candidate, not a fresh Vue-to-San batch or independent-test result.
The regression gate does not prove every browser event contract or source assignment semantics.
Browser manual review was not performed.
next_step: Prepare a fresh one-sample development batch with an evidence-backed fourth repair round so the five-error specialized prompt can run after the two deterministic rounds and first broad model round; freeze before execution.
